_comment: What this repo vendors from the devcontainer-sandbox template, and where to pull it from. scripts/sync-from-template.sh reads this; .github/workflows/template-sync.yml runs it on a schedule and opens a PR whenever a vendored copy drifts from the canonical upstream. Two things are synced: shared Claude Code skills (into .claude/skills/) and shared docs (any src→dest path pair — the standards doc and the PR template). The repo's own skills — listed in "own_skills" — are never touched. To carry another shared skill, add its directory name to "shared_skills"; to carry another shared doc, add a {src,dest} pair to "shared_docs". A doc missing upstream is a warning, not an error: the sync skips it and leaves the local copy alone. NOTE: standards/HOSTING-SECURITY.md is deliberately NOT vendored here. This repo is public and that doc describes private infrastructure. Do not add it back.
